description: Get file content as plain text by default. Set `with_metadata=true` for binary files, or when you need the SHA/encoding/links from the full `ContentsResponse` (e.g. before a follow-up `update_file` call). Optional `start_line` and `end_line` request a 1-indexed inclusive line range; out-of-range values clamp to the file extent. With `with_metadata=true` the range replaces the content with that slice and keeps the metadata. A whole file, or a range, over 1 MiB of text is refused with a message asking for a narrower `start_line`/`end_line`.

end_line.description: Optional 1-indexed last line of the slice (inclusive). Defaults to the file's last line when only start_line is set.

start_line.description: Optional 1-indexed first line of the slice (inclusive). Defaults to 1 when only end_line is set.

with_metadata.description: Return the full ContentsResponse (sha, encoding, links, type, size, base64 content) instead of plain text.

name: get_file_content
